detected_issues.description: Dialogue and speech-timing issues found in the source, with concrete line references and spoken-line repairs.

description.description: Identify the speaker, line, exchange, or scene boundary where dialogue connectivity or timing fails.

correction_applied.description: Describe the dialogue-only change made in each variation.

refined_scripts.description: Dialogue-refined variations preserving the source story and non-dialogue details.

script.description: Complete script with refined spoken lines and only necessary speech cues or scene boundaries; story and action remain faithful.

notes.description: Dialogue approach, source-story safeguards, scene-count departures, and remaining limitations.

scene_timings.description: One speech/non-speech timing breakdown for each actual scene, even when the target scene count is exceeded.

dialogue_duration_seconds.description: Spoken dialogue duration calculated from dialogue word count and wps_range.

non_dialogue_duration_seconds.description: Duration allocated to non-dialogue elements (actions, pauses, transitions).

total_duration_seconds.description: Total scene duration (dialogue + non-dialogue), fitting within scene_duration_seconds.

detected_issues.description: Arun proposes leaving before dawn immediately after Maya mentions the letter; Maya’s reply about fear does not answer his proposal.
detected_issues.correction_applied: Connected Arun’s departure proposal to the letter and let him ask if she opened it; Maya’s refusal and fear remain intact.

refined_scripts.script:
INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT
MAYA holds an unopened letter.
MAYA
The letter came today.
ARUN
Then we should leave before dawn. Have you opened it?
MAYA
No. I’m afraid of what it says.
refined_scripts.notes: Arun’s response now follows Maya’s reveal. The departure plan, unopened letter, and Maya’s fear remain unchanged.
